comment: Independent artifact.c witness: a human Valkyrie in debug mode wishes for and wields a silver saber, creates a werewolf and waits with forced searches. The werewolf's bite makes her feverish (uhitm.c mhitm_ad_were()), and retouch_equipment() reaches retouch_object(), which says she can't handle the saber anymore and drops it. The port plans each monster move before playing it; that planning pass must not print the retouch message on the live screen, where it added an extra --More-- before the bite.
